sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
For the container, see Medicine case.

Medcase is a Loot Container in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A 4x3 grid plastic medical case that only spawns medical items. Very similar to the Medbag, but cannot spawn medkits except for the AI-2 medkit.
